manifest_role: Content-bound enumeration of every canon subject pending baseline review, with the disposition and written reasoning of one accountable reviewer. Presenting this manifest to --accept advances the baseline. It closes no work item, certifies no stage, and changes no status.
instructions: Fill reviewer_ref, and per subject a disposition (unaffected | successor_required | blocked) and a review_note that argues it from what actually changed.

`unaffected` must be ARGUED. Say why this subject's change does not reach the stages, modules, and work items named in review_required below. An unargued `unaffected` is a mechanical accept with extra steps.
Never rewrite a verified closure to absorb a semantic change: disposition it `successor_required` and open a successor record that states what must now be proven.
Do not edit the ids or digests. They bind this manifest to one exact revision, and --accept refuses if they drift.

subjects.review_note: authored_by_this_branch: Records the measured zero-reference execution gap and routes it to the admitted M5 seam; the named M5 successor must prove the five-owner composition before participant execution.

authored_by_this_branch: Changes GoalRun execution coverage from implicit application execution to an explicit missing five-owner seam; current closures cannot absorb that new proof obligation, so the M5 successor is required.

authored_by_this_branch: Makes daemon thread, fork, managed-session, launch-recipe, and harness-binding records the sole execution owners; a successor must migrate current GoalRun paths and prove those owners are crossed.

authored_by_this_branch: Restricts ioi.ai to projecting over daemon-owned orchestration and forbids application-local orchestration truth; the M5 seam is required before participant execution can claim conformance.

authored_by_this_branch: Recasts executing GoalRuns as application compositions over daemon orchestration while retaining app vocabulary; the current zero-reference runtime leaves an explicit successor obligation.
authored_by_this_branch: Clarifies that Goal Space requests and projects execution but does not own thread/session/harness truth; the M5 successor must implement this boundary.

authored_by_this_branch: Adds the normative five-owner execution composition for GoalRun and distinguishes identity from execution; runtime_goal_pursuit and goalrun_routes currently satisfy none of the five references, requiring the admitted successor.

authored_by_this_branch: New accepted ruling removes the second orchestration spine, explicitly leaves M4 truth/projection clauses unchanged, and assigns implementation and harness-to-harness proof to the first M5 cut.
authored_by_this_branch: Index-only addition of ADR 0031; it introduces no obligation beyond the ADR itself, which is separately dispositioned successor_required and routed to the M5 seam.
